header.title: FadeTransition
header.description: Opacity enter/exit for mount and unmount. Toggle `isIn` to fade in or out; the node stays mounted until the exit transition ends. Pass `{ enter, exit }` on `duration`, `delay`, or `easing` for split timing.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine props, toggle fade in/out, and watch the generated code. Enter uses `enter` timing; exit uses `exit`.
playground.label: Fade panel

base.title: Base
base.description: With defaults (`duration={300}`, `easing="standard"`) the panel fades in/out. After exit it unmounts unless you use `keepMounted` or `unmountOnExit`.

enter.title: Enter
enter.description: Starts hidden (`isIn={false}`). Enter uses `duration={450}` and the `enter` easing token.

exit.title: Exit
exit.description: Starts visible. Exit uses `duration={280}` and the `exit` easing token. The node stays mounted until opacity finishes.

timing.title: Enter / exit timing
timing.description: `duration`, `delay`, and `easing` accept `{ enter, exit }`. Enter is slower with delay; exit is snappy.

slow.title: Slow
slow.description: `duration={800}` for a longer fade when you want the change to read clearly.

keepMounted.title: keepMounted
keepMounted.description: With `keepMounted`, exit hides the host with `display: none` instead of unmounting. Re-enter restores the same DOM node.

initial.title: initial false
initial.description: `initial={false}` skips motion on the first mount (snaps in). Later toggles still fade. Use Remount to see the skip again.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: With `isDisabled` (or `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`) the host snaps to the target state with no interpolation.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, fade classes merge onto the single child (no extra wrapper).

texts.title: Notice
texts.body: Slotted host — the fade runs on the Card.

utilities.title: Utility classes
utilities.description: Pass `utilities.css` helpers via `classNames.root`. This demo applies `gemst-relative` and `gemst-overflow-hidden`.

header.title: FadeTransition API
header.description: Props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `FadeTransition`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for enter, exit, timing, and keepMounted.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/fade-transition` with its `fade-transition.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. In that case classes and styles merge with the child's, and if both define the same handler, the child's runs first. The component handles onTransitionEnd internally (to detect the end of opacity) and then calls yours.

items.presence: This is a presence transition: the control that toggles isIn should reflect state (label, aria-pressed, or your pattern). Do not convey information with the fade alone.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the host snaps to the final state. The preference is read each render; it is not live-listened.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion on the root. Use only when motion is essential.
items.keepMounted: With keepMounted the node stays in the DOM with display: none after exit. It should not receive focus or be announced while hidden.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a child with the right semantics (Card, section, div): that element is the fade host.

items.root: Root (`div`, or the child with `asChild`). `inline-flex`; transitions `opacity`.
items.prep: Enter priming: no transition so the resting state cannot flash.
items.keepMountedHidden: Host hidden after exit with `keepMounted` (`display: none`).

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline each render (`0ms` when `isDisabled`, reduced motion, or keep-mounted hidden).

items.duration: Duration of the current phase. Default `300ms`.
items.delay: Delay of the current phase. Default `0ms`.
items.easing: Easing of the current phase. Default `standard`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables used as CSS defaults.

items.easingStandard: Default for `--gemst-fade-easing`. The component writes the resolved curve inline — use `easing` to change it.

content.title: Content
content.description: What fades and where it mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Presence and how it stays mounted.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: In milliseconds. `enter` applies on fade in and `exit` on fade out.

items.children: Content that fades in and out.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child (no extra wrapper).
items.isIn: `true` fades in and stays mounted; `false` fades out and unmounts after the transition (unless `keepMounted`).
items.keepMounted: After exit, hides the host with `display: none` instead of unmounting. Ignored when `unmountOnExit`.
items.unmountOnExit: Unmounts immediately on exit (skips the exit fade).
items.initial: `false` skips motion on the first mount. Later toggles still animate. Default `true`.
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, `enter` is fade in and `exit` is fade out.
items.delay: Wait before starting. Accepts `{ enter, exit }`.
items.easing: Token (`standard`, `enter`, `exit`, `emphasized`, `linear`), timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Default `standard`.
items.isDisabled: Snaps to the target state with no interpolation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onFade: Fires when the fade is active (`isIn` true).
items.outFade: Fires on exit (`isIn` false), disable, or unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with `--gemst-fade-*`.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
